question: What components of social prescribing programmes affect loneliness, health, or wellbeing among older adults?
eligibility: Social prescribing or link-worker referral to community activities.
Reports loneliness, health, or wellbeing outcomes.
to_date_source: Day after latest Entrez date among included PubMed records (lower bound; review search cutoff not independently confirmed).
source: Rapo et al. 2023, Critical components of social prescribing programmes with a focus on older adults. PMID 37485982; PMCID PMC10478612. https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10478612/
original_screening_load_source: Rapo et al. 2023 (PMC10478612) PRISMA: 578 deduplicated records screened (1,193 identified minus 267 automatic and 348 manual duplicates).
notes: Gold contains 10 of 12 included articles with PubMed records; 2 table references had no exact PubMed title record.
